text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous-chan! I'm making a swiss roll 
for your birthday this year~! And the 
length is—

text_block_list.name: Akebono & Biko
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous-chan, ten portions!! 
Marvelous-senpai, ten portions!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
In other words, 14.5 meters, right!? But, 
but, how do we roll it up!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
We'll all line up side-by-side to roll 
them! I invited Mayano, Laurel-senpai, and 
the others too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, it's a loooong cake, after all. I 
even made a juicy meat zone♪

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Amazing, amazing! All of us 
together! ...Waaaah~~ ☆★

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Call out to each other! Unite your hearts! 
And roll, roll, roll away!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Of course, with that cheer! Ehehe, let's 
practice first! Ready, set♪
